title: Ok, but would not buy again.
text:
Ok, but would not buy again.. These fit in our air fryer all right (basket-style Cosori), but for some reason, none of us like using them very much. We very much prefer to put a foil sheet in the bottom below the basket.

Maybe they will win me over some day. But for now, they are just annoying. I would not repurchase these.
